query: What was the largest passenger capacity of the plane type used for BOAC Flight 911 ?

pipeline_result.response: The largest passenger capacity of the plane type used on BOAC Flight 911 was 1,200 passengers. This was achieved by operating a Boeing 747-400 aircraft at its maximum range of 18,000 nautical miles (33,000 km). The flight took off from Heathrow Airport in London and landed at Gatwick Airport in the United Kingdom.
